claim_summary: Exact seven-coefficient occupation polynomial for all b+k=6 ground sectors at h=1; exact zero-temperature degeneracies and low-temperature scaling profile.
integrity: Exact integer cyclic transfer computation and independently structured exhaustive vertex recursion, with source and proof supplied; independent scientific validation has not occurred.
object: Three-state antiferromagnetic Potts spins on the labelled dodecahedral graph GP(10,2), with nonnegative state-3 cost.
scientific_limitations: Finite 20-site graph and specified Potts bond energy only; no infinite-volume transition, no assertion that generic field-Potts partition methods are new; broader publication-priority checks remain necessary.
title: Exact critical occupation polynomial of a dodecahedral Potts antiferromagnet
